title: Anime establishing wide
prompt: no humans, empty soccer stadium at night, floodlights, empty stands, confetti on wet grass, wide shot, scenery, cinematic lighting, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
why: Danbooru grammar: comma-separated tags, subject first, camera word ('wide shot') as a tag rather than a sentence. `no humans` is a real danbooru tag and the reliable way to get an empty frame - it is NOT negation, which SDXL cannot do in a positive prompt.
